zh-CN.label: 人际密度：较低
zh-CN.meaning: 工作中互动、会议、协调和读人信号的频率
zh-CN.fit_signal: 观察互动频率是否挤压专注、边界和恢复。
zh-CN.strain_signal: 可能增加消耗的条件：如果规则、权力差、支持系统和恢复空间不清楚，人际密度较低也可能带来额外压力。
zh-CN.interview_question: 这个环境的低互动是真正稳定，还是只在出问题时集中爆发？
role_observation_checklist: 会议是否有明确目的和结束条件
反馈是否具体到行为和下一步
是否允许暂时退出高情绪对话
zh-CN.team_risk: 互动节奏不清时，协调工作容易落到少数人身上。
zh-CN.recovery_condition: 核对会议间隔、安静工作时段和临时退出机制。
zh-CN.what_to_verify: 这个环境的低互动是真正稳定，还是只在出问题时集中爆发？ 同时观察具体角色、组织文化、管理方式、权力结构、团队资源和你的当前生活阶段。
zh-CN.do_not_overread: 人际密度只是待核对的工作条件，不能证明岗位匹配。

en.label: Interpersonal density: low
en.meaning: how often the work requires interaction, meetings, coordination, and reading social cues
en.fit_signal: Observe whether interaction frequency leaves enough focus, boundaries, and recovery.
en.strain_signal: Possible strain condition: if rules, power differences, support, and recovery space are unclear, low interpersonal density can still create pressure.
en.interview_question: Is the low interaction genuinely stable, or does communication pile up when something goes wrong?
role_observation_checklist: Whether meetings have a clear purpose and end point
Whether feedback names behavior and next steps
Whether people can step out of emotionally loaded conversations when needed
en.team_risk: When interaction rhythm is unclear, coordination work can collect around a few people.
en.recovery_condition: Check meeting spacing, quiet-work time, and whether people can step out briefly.
en.what_to_verify: Is the low interaction genuinely stable, or does communication pile up when something goes wrong? Also observe the actual role, organization culture, management style, power structure, team resources, and your current life context.
en.do_not_overread: Interpersonal density is a condition to check, not evidence of job fit.

meta.risk_notes: Work-environment variable only; not career advice, selection evidence, role-fit proof, diagnosis, ability evidence, or performance prediction.

zh-CN.label: 情绪劳动：较低
zh-CN.meaning: 工作是否经常要求承接、安抚、协调或管理他人情绪
zh-CN.fit_signal: 观察安抚、协调和承接他人情绪是否被正式承认。
zh-CN.strain_signal: 可能增加消耗的条件：如果规则、权力差、支持系统和恢复空间不清楚，情绪劳动较低也可能带来额外压力。
zh-CN.interview_question: 情绪劳动低，是因为流程清楚，还是因为情绪问题被延后处理？
role_observation_checklist: 情绪承接是否被正式承认
是否有复盘和轮换机制
是否把“会安抚人”默认成个人义务
zh-CN.team_risk: 情绪劳动隐形时，最愿意倾听的人容易长期多承担。
zh-CN.recovery_condition: 核对情绪劳动是否有督导、轮换、边界和恢复安排。
zh-CN.what_to_verify: 情绪劳动低，是因为流程清楚，还是因为情绪问题被延后处理？ 同时观察具体角色、组织文化、管理方式、权力结构、团队资源和你的当前生活阶段。
zh-CN.do_not_overread: 情绪劳动高低不能推出职业适合度或表现。

en.label: Emotional labor: low
en.meaning: how often the work asks people to absorb, soothe, coordinate, or manage others’ emotions
en.fit_signal: Observe whether soothing, coordinating, and carrying emotion are formally recognized.
en.strain_signal: Possible strain condition: if rules, power differences, support, and recovery space are unclear, low emotional labor can still create pressure.
en.interview_question: Is emotional labor low because process is clear, or because emotional issues are postponed?
role_observation_checklist: Whether emotional labor is formally recognized
Whether there is review and rotation
Whether soothing others is treated as a personal obligation
en.team_risk: When emotional labor is invisible, willing listeners can end up carrying it repeatedly.
en.recovery_condition: Check for supervision, rotation, boundaries, and recovery around emotional labor.
en.what_to_verify: Is emotional labor low because process is clear, or because emotional issues are postponed? Also observe the actual role, organization culture, management style, power structure, team resources, and your current life context.
en.do_not_overread: Emotional-labor level does not establish career fit or performance.

meta.risk_notes: Work-environment variable only; not career advice, selection evidence, role-fit proof, diagnosis, ability evidence, or performance prediction.

zh-CN.label: 冲突频率：较低
zh-CN.meaning: 工作中分歧、投诉、谈判、博弈或高压对话出现的频率
zh-CN.fit_signal: 观察分歧出现后是否有暂停、升级和修复规则。
zh-CN.strain_signal: 可能增加消耗的条件：如果规则、权力差、支持系统和恢复空间不清楚，冲突频率较低也可能带来额外压力。
zh-CN.interview_question: 低冲突是否来自透明规则，还是来自回避和沉默？
role_observation_checklist: 分歧是否能被记录和复盘
权力差是否影响谁能说话
是否有安全退出或升级机制
zh-CN.team_risk: 冲突规则缺失时，缓冲责任容易落到最愿意让步的人身上。
zh-CN.recovery_condition: 核对冲突中谁能暂停、谁来决定，以及如何恢复合作。
zh-CN.what_to_verify: 低冲突是否来自透明规则，还是来自回避和沉默？ 同时观察具体角色、组织文化、管理方式、权力结构、团队资源和你的当前生活阶段。
zh-CN.do_not_overread: 冲突频率不是你能否胜任某项工作的证据。

en.label: Conflict frequency: low
en.meaning: how often disagreement, complaints, negotiation, trade-offs, or high-pressure conversations appear
en.fit_signal: Observe whether disagreement has clear rules for pausing, escalation, and repair.
en.strain_signal: Possible strain condition: if rules, power differences, support, and recovery space are unclear, low conflict frequency can still create pressure.
en.interview_question: Does low conflict come from clear rules, or from avoidance and silence?
role_observation_checklist: Whether disagreements are documented and reviewed
Whether power differences shape who can speak
Whether there is a safe exit or escalation path
en.team_risk: Without conflict rules, buffering often falls to the person most willing to yield.
en.recovery_condition: Check who can pause a conflict, who decides, and how collaboration resumes.
en.what_to_verify: Does low conflict come from clear rules, or from avoidance and silence? Also observe the actual role, organization culture, management style, power structure, team resources, and your current life context.
en.do_not_overread: Conflict frequency is not evidence that you can or cannot do a job.

meta.risk_notes: Work-environment variable only; not career advice, selection evidence, role-fit proof, diagnosis, ability evidence, or performance prediction.
